svg.title: APC lift + zero-point release + HMC table clamp – hydraulic circuit (example)
svg.text: Circuit diagram (ISO 1219-2 style) – HMC power unit for APC lift, zero-point release and rotary table clamp (guide 25 example 2)
Lift Ø50/28 at 10 MPa (decided 2026-11-12). Pump 4 cm³/rev + 1.5 kW charges a 4 L accumulator 10.8–11.5 MPa; clamp branches 5 MPa. Rest = de-energised.
tank 25 L, HLP 46 (or VG 32 as the clamp makers specify), ISO 4406 17/15/12 target (zero-point modules + rotary union), breather 3 µm, level/temp switch
Sequence (PLC): 2V1 on → 2S1 'unclamped' → 1Y1 lift → rotate 180° (1V2 holds) → 1Y2 lower → 2V1 off (springs clamp) → air seating check.
Table indexing: 3V1 on (unclamp) → B-axis turns → 3V1 off → 3S1 'clamped' → cutting allowed. Pump: 0V5 on below 10.8 MPa, off at 11.5 MPa (≈ 43 cycles/h).
Spindle tool unclamp is not drawn (own booster or a 4th branch).
